en.topic_title: China confirms 2 sailors died in 2025 South China Sea collision
en.topic_summary:
Beijing has quietly confirmed the deaths of two Chinese sailors in a collision in the contested South China Sea, according to government statements nearly a year after the incident.



This handout video grab released and taken on August 11, 2025 by the Philippine Coast Guard shows an incident between a Chinese Navy vessel (L) and a Chinese Coast Guard ship (R). Photo by Handout/Philippine Coast Guard (PCG).
